description: Compute logo clear space and minimum sizes. Give width and height (any unit, pass `unit`), optionally `letterform` (height of a capital or the x-height in the same unit), `kind` (wordmark, lockup, symbol, monogram) and `clearSpaceMultiple` (default 1 letterform). Returns clear space on each side, the total exclusion zone, a compact clear space (half), minimum height and width for screen (smallest letterform 8 px) and print (1.5 mm), and a size table for common widths marking where the logo falls below the minimum. If `letterform` is omitted it is estimated and the result says so. The floors are conventions; your brand guide may differ.

clearSpaceMultiple.description: Clear space as a multiple of the letterform, 0.25 to 4. Default 1

letterform.description: Height of a reference letterform (capital or x-height), same unit

unit.description: Unit of width, height and letterform, e.g. px, mm. Default px
